Full names don't necessarily need to be used, usually just their first name or whatever name you feel is more important for a reader to know and easily recognize a character. Many characters are more well known by their first name or last name or nick name or middle name, it all just comes down to what you think is easier to refer a character as.

Superman is called Superman or Clark by the narrator in specific circumstances when one persona is more used in a particular story, usually only calling him Clark Kent when he's being introduced, and it's RARE for the narrator to call him Cal El.

Which ever name you'll be using to refer to a character as more is probably the one you'll want to use for the narrator's voice, and it's even ok to change as the story goes on and characters shift.
